text:
kai (SRE): Quick idea for postmortem follow-ups: run a 10-business-day 'closure window' where each remediation must have owner, due_date, and a three-state flow (triage -> fix -> verify). Weekly 30m sync until closed.

Rina: ok, light and prescriptive. what fields do you actually want in the tracker?

kai (SRE): Minimal: id, owner, svc, bucket, priority (P0/P1/P2), due_date (YYYY-MM-DD), status, verify_link, rc_bucket (infra/config/deploy/third_party), recurrence_flag. owner+due_date required.

omar: +1. suggest a "stale_after" automation: ops-bot marks actions stale after 14 days and rotates a review owner.

ops-bot: automated: "Note: 2 open pm actions >7d for omar. Use /pm-list to view."

devin: who attends the weekly 30m? keep it small pls.

kai (SRE): owners + current IC (or former if handoff week) + one PM/infra SME. Agenda: roll call 3m each, blockers, recurrence signal check, next steps.

Rina: rotation change suggestion: move IC rotation to 6-week blocks with a 1-week overlap handoff to preserve continuity for follow-ups.

omar: overlap seems helpful. stops lost actions when IC swaps mid-remediation.

devin: verification requirements? teams often never close things.

kai (SRE): keep verification light: 1-paragraph note + link to dashboard or smoke-test steps. optionally a tiny checklist for deploy+smoke.

Rina: can we auto-surface recurring buckets? e.g., if svc+bucket appears >1 in 30d, flag.

omar: yes, tag rows and run weekly rollup query. if flagged twice in 60d, schedule a separate recurrence workshop.

ops-bot: automated: "Label 'follow-through' applied to incidents 5123, 5178."

kai (SRE): next steps: i'll add a one-page playbook + tracker CSV template and post in #eng-oncall by EOD. omar will run pilot for incidents 5123 and 5178 starting Monday and host the first weekly sync.

Rina: thanks. if pilot looks good, small repo with template + bot scripts + recommended IC overlap changes is the rollout path.

omar: i'll capture simple metrics: median time-to-verify, stale_count, recurrence_flags. report after both windows close.

kai (SRE): perfect. low-friction, measurable pilot.

ops-bot: automated: "Reminder scheduled: weekly follow-through sync invite created."
